label: Hop's Trevenant / Hop's Snorlax
covers: Hop's Trevenant / Hop’s Cramorant / Hop’s Snorlax
summary: All-single-prize Hop's aggro-control / revenge-trap deck. Stacks three pre-Weakness +30 boosts (Snorlax's Extra Helpings aura from the bench + Hop's Choice Band + Postwick) on a Stage-1 Trevenant: Corner (PCC, 90->180) traps your Active with a no-retreat lock; Horrifying Revenge (C, 30->~130->~220, free with Choice Band) punishes every return-KO -- the plan is to make YOU trade badly. Beat it by racing the fragile setup and OHKOing THROUGH Weakness (Darkness x2 on the 140 Trevenant / Fighting x2 on the 150 Snorlax aura -- cuts through the +90 buffer AND ignores Mist), denying the Revenge trigger (control trade timing; never over-commit to a straight KO race), overwriting Postwick, and starving the all-special energy base. Don't waste effect-riders on Mist-holders and don't sink removal into self-shuffling Dudunsparce.

threats.why: Wincon. Corner (PCC, 90->180 boosted) no-retreat traps the Active; Horrifying Revenge (C, 30 -> ~130 if a Hop's body was KO'd by an attack last turn -> ~220 boosted, free with Choice Band) punishes return-KOs. Cheap 1-prize Stage 1. Darkness x2, resists Fighting -30.

Extra Helpings +30 aura (always-on from the bench) is the damage floor lifting Corner/Revenge over our HP thresholds; also a 150-HP wall + Dynamic Press burst (140, self-80). Remove it by KO (Fighting x2) or ability-lock -- a gust does NOT disable the aura (it works from the bench).
The deck's only reach to our bench; gusts a fragile piece Active to KO around a wall or reposition. Don't leave a snipeable key piece benched assuming it's safe.

targets.why: THE win-condition body — the top-priority target (ADR-0051 `prize_liability` = 'the payoff to remove'; it is 1 prize, the role is not about prize count). 140 HP, Darkness x2 -> a 70-base hit OHKOs it THROUGH the +90 Extra-Helpings/Choice-Band/Postwick buffer AND ignores Mist. Removing the Trevenant is the game: it is the only body that carries Corner (no-retreat trap) and Horrifying Revenge. Not immune and not Tera — unlike a Crustle-class wall, this payoff IS targetable, so it must carry a role or the agent rides only its under-read printed 90 (real boosted output ~180-220).
70 HP, 1 prize, Darkness x2; base of the ONLY wincon line. Snipe/gust in the evolution window to deny a Trevenant prize-free.
